info.name: NEXUS - Saga Orchestrator
info.description: Orchestrates distributed sagas (TransferSaga, OnboardingSaga). All endpoints are internal for monitoring, debugging, and recovery. Port: 8095

item.name: Get Transfer Saga by Transaction ID

request.description:
Get the TransferSaga state for a transaction.

Response 200: TransferSagaState {
  sagaId: UUID,
  transactionId: UUID,
  currentStep: BALANCE_RESERVING | FRAUD_CHECKING | LEDGER_POSTING | BALANCE_FINALIZING | NOTIFICATION_SENDING | COMPLETED | COMPENSATION_COMPLETED | PERMANENTLY_FAILED,
  sourceAccountId: UUID,
  targetAccountId: UUID,
  amount: BigDecimal,
  startedAt: Instant,
  expiresAt: Instant,
  completedAt: Instant (null if in-flight)
}
Response 404: Not Found

item.name: Get Onboarding Saga by User ID

request.description:
Get the OnboardingSaga state for a user.

Response 200: OnboardingSagaState {
  sagaId: UUID,
  userId: UUID,
  currentStep: USER_REGISTERED | KYC_INITIATED | KYC_APPROVED | ACCOUNTS_CREATED | COMPLETED | FAILED,
  startedAt: Instant, completedAt: Instant (null if in-flight)
}
Response 404: Not Found

Real-time saga processing statistics.

Response 200: { activeTransferSagas: long, activeOnboardingSagas: long, status: 'OPERATIONAL' }

Returns TransferSagas that are past their expiry time and not in a terminal state. Used by monitoring and the nightly cleanup job.

Response 200: { stuckTransferSagas: List<TransferSagaState> }
